model_rules.culture: Influential >=90% of surviving civs; Popular to all others for 15 turns
model_rules.domination: Own >=70% of founding capitals and own home capital; lead armies for 45 turns
model_rules.diplomacy: At a periodic vote, >=27 delegate proxies and >=4 city-state allies
model_rules.no_time: No turn-limit score victory; simulation stops at 1450 if none qualifies
model_rules.war: Territorial wars have active fronts, per-turn casualties, multi-turn sieges and peace treaties
model_rules.counterplay: Visible victory threat raises war incentives; targeted diplomatic and cultural responses
model_rules.citystate: 11 city-states with persistently competitive influence bidding
model_rules.geography: Procedurally generated land and schematic city-radius political borders
model_rules.restrictions: Human-only civilizations treated as expert AI to allow a hypothetical 56-civ contest
